------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

------------------

The App Components Team is a forward-thinking, platform-focused product engineering team dedicated to crafting the cohesive, high-performing building blocks that define Rippling’s "Enterprise Studio" experience.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a **Software Engineer I (Full Stack)** on this team you will be responsible to build and scale the systems that power these components. While your primary focus will be on the backend, this is a truly full-stack role. You will help design the distributed systems that power our platform and also contribute to React and React Native code to deliver polished end-to-end product experiences.

You will be responsible for building scalable backend services, APIs, and data models, while partnering closely with product and design to ensure the underlying complexity is translated into seamless, high-performance user experiences.

**What you will do**

* Design and implement scalable backend services using Python and Golang to support complex enterprise data modeling and product use cases.
* Contribute to systems that operate at scale, with exposure to distributed systems challenges and technologies such as Kafka, Flink, and AWS.
* While your strength lies in backend engineering, you will also contribute to the frontend codebase. You will write high-quality React and React Native code to ship end-to-end features and help deliver intuitive, performant UI components.
* Take ownership of meaningful product initiatives from early problem definition through implementation. You will help shape technical designs for new "App Studio" capabilities and deliver robust solutions.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, participate in thoughtful code reviews, and contribute to strong engineering standards across backend and frontend systems.
* Work closely with Product, Design, and other engineers to break down complex user problems and build components that are technically strong and practically useful for teams building on top of them.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 1+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong experience building production systems
* Proficiency in building scalable backend services. Experience with Python, Django, Golang, MongoDB, and AWS is highly preferred.
* Comfortable in writing and shipping production code in React and React Native. You should understand component lifecycles, state management, and mobile constraints well enough to build and iterate on UI for the systems you own.

* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

job.title: Sr Software Engineer @ Huron Consulting Group (KA, IN)
job.description:
Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We collaborate with education organizations to develop strategies and implement solutions that enable the transformative change our clients need to own their future. Together, we empower clients to drive innovation, create sustainable funding streams and deliver better student outcomes.  
  
Today, leaders of higher education institutions and academic medical centers are spending too much time reacting to market forces, rather than focusing on the essential priorities that help students, faculty and staff thrive. The most productive path forward requires an intentional approach and innovative thinking, whereby stakeholders across the entire institution rally around a shared vision and embrace the hard work of effecting change.  
  
You’ll help our clients to achieve organizational effectiveness, improve student outcomes, implement new technologies and align resources and investments to ensure long-term sustainability.  
  
Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Huron, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise software products built on the Huron platform. You will apply deep engineering expertise to build scalable, AI-augmented applications, mentor engineers, and partner closely with Product, Implementation, and Support teams within Huron's Higher Education practice.

**Primary responsibilities**

**Architecture and technical leadership**

* Lead design reviews, and drive technical decisions on scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Translate product requirements into clean, well-tested implementations; author architecture decision records (ADRs) and developer documentation.
* Define and govern engineering quality standards, coding conventions, and peer review norms across the team.

**AI-assisted and agentic development**

* **AI-assisted development:** Leverage GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and comparable agentic coding assistants across code authoring, review, test generation, and documentation to increase quality and velocity.
* **AI agent development:** Design, build, and maintain AI agents and multi-agent workflows; define agent instructions, skills, memory, and tool integrations; evaluate agent behavior in production.
* **MCP and tool integrations:** Apply Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent patterns to connect AI models to internal tools, APIs, and data sources for agentic workflows.
* Stay current with the agentic AI landscape; bring forward-looking proposals to the engineering team.

**Full-stack development and collaboration**

* Build high-quality client-side and server-side code using modern frameworks; design RESTful APIs (OpenAPI standard); develop microservices on Azure or AWS.
* Write and execute comprehensive unit and integration test cases; troubleshoot deployment and environment issues across multiple projects.
* Mentor engineers, lead code reviews, and contribute actively to sprint ceremonies in a globally distributed Agile team.

**Required qualifications**

**Core**

* Bachelor’s in computer science or related field (or equivalent experience); 6+ years of progressive software development experience on a commercial product.
* Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, system design, and distributed computing.
* Production-quality C# (.NET); React or comparable front-end framework; NUnit/xUnit testing; Git/Azure DevOps source control.
* Relational database experience (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) with query optimization; RESTful API design; Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Demonstrated experience with performance engineering, scalability design, and observability practices (logging, metrics, distributed tracing) in production systems.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services including Lambda, ECS, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and related cloud-native tooling.

**AI and agentic development tools**

* Hands-on use of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor to write, refactor, and review production code; ability to craft effective prompts and system instructions.
* Solid understanding of AI agents, skills, and tool-calling; ability to configure and evaluate agentic workflows for multi-step development tasks.
* Working knowledge of an LLM API or agent orchestration framework (Anthropic API, OpenAI API, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar) is a strong plus.

**Preferred qualifications**

* HTML5, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript with React or Next.js; cloud-native development on Azure or AWS; Docker and Kubernetes.
* TDD/BDD methodologies; AI observability tooling; familiarity with the Microsoft development ecosystem.

  + Experience with Maven, Git, Jenkins DevOps

* E. / B.Tech / MCA in Computer Science or related field
* At least 5 years’ experience with custom application development and at least 2 years experience with designing and solutioning, with an overall 8+ years IT experience.
